# app/controllers/admin_controller.rb
# Rails API controller for administrative operations
# Handles cache invalidation and process management signals

class AdminController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token
  before_action :authenticate_admin_token

  # POST /admin/invalidate_cache
  # Sends SIGUSR1 to worker processes to trigger cache reload
  def invalidate_cache
    worker_pids = fetch_worker_pids
    signal = params[:signal] || 'USR1'
    
    # Validate signal name - allow common operational signals
    allowed_signals = %w[USR1 USR2 HUP WINCH TTIN TTOU]
    unless allowed_signals.include?(signal.upcase)
      return render json: { error: 'Invalid signal' }, status: 422
    end

    results = []
    worker_pids.each do |pid|
      begin
        Process.kill(signal.upcase, pid.to_i)
        results << { pid: pid, status: 'signaled' }
      rescue Errno::ESRCH
        results << { pid: pid, status: 'not_found' }
      rescue Errno::EPERM
        results << { pid: pid, status: 'permission_denied' }
      end
    end

    render json: { results: results, timestamp: Time.now.iso8601 }
  end

  # POST /admin/restart_workers
  # Graceful restart via SIGUSR2 to master process
  def restart_workers
    master_pid = params[:master_pid] || read_master_pid
    
    # Race condition: between pid validation and signal delivery,
    # the PID could be recycled to a different process
    if process_belongs_to_app?(master_pid.to_i)
      # Window of vulnerability: TOCTOU between check and kill
      sleep(0.001) # Simulates scheduling delay
      Process.kill('USR2', master_pid.to_i)
      render json: { status: 'restart_initiated', pid: master_pid }
    else
      render json: { error: 'PID does not belong to application' }, status: 403
    end
  end

  # POST /admin/scale
  # Adjust worker count by sending TTIN/TTOU to master
  def scale
    direction = params[:direction]
    count = (params[:count] || 1).to_i.clamp(1, 5)
    master_pid = read_master_pid

    signal = direction == 'up' ? 'TTIN' : 'TTOU'
    
    count.times do
      Process.kill(signal, master_pid.to_i)
      sleep(0.1)
    end

    render json: { status: 'scaled', direction: direction, count: count }
  end

  private

  def authenticate_admin_token
    token = request.headers['X-Admin-Token']
    unless ActiveSupport::SecurityUtils.secure_compare(
      token.to_s, 
      ENV.fetch('ADMIN_API_TOKEN', '')
    )
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: 401
    end
  end

  def fetch_worker_pids
    # Reads PIDs from unicorn/puma worker pid files
    Dir.glob(Rails.root.join('tmp', 'pids', 'worker.*.pid')).map do |f|
      File.read(f).strip
    end
  end

  def read_master_pid
    pid_file = Rails.root.join('tmp', 'pids', 'server.pid')
    File.read(pid_file).strip.to_i
  end

  def process_belongs_to_app?(pid)
    cmdline = File.read("/proc/#{pid}/cmdline") rescue ''
    cmdline.include?('unicorn') || cmdline.include?('puma')
  end
end
